title: Eventual vanishing of a germ in an approximation counit kernel
statement: Let I be small and cofiltered, D:I→Sch have qcqs objects and affine transition maps, and let s exhibit X as its limit. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf and A its approximation diagram [def-sc-affine-limit-sheaf-approximation]. For x∈X let P be the geometric stalk at Spec(AlgebraicClosure κ(x))→X. If i∈I^op and t∈P(A_i) has zero image under the approximation counit P(A_i)→P(F), then there exist j∈I^op and f:i→j with P(A(f))(t)=0. No torsion or cohomology bound is assumed.

source.place: Proof step 1: Eventual vanishing of a germ in an approximation counit kernel

proof.text: The stalk isomorphism for inverse image represents t by a section a of F on p_i^*V_i, where V_i is a pointed etale neighbourhood on D_i. The source-library stalk-of-transpose identity (Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso_inv_app_comp_sheafFiber_map) identifies the counit image with the germ of a. Since it is zero, the filtered-stalk equality criterion gives a pointed etale W→p_i^*V_i where a restricts to zero. Shrink W to an affine pointed neighbourhood.

Reindex the overcategory Over i by a final directed poset. Empty finite-diagram descent produces a qcqs model W_j over a stage j→i. The base-change cone is a limit. Apply Mathlib Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation to the map from that limit to V_i over D_i. The hypotheses hold because the model and its affine base changes are qcqs and V_i→D_i is etale. This descends the representing map to a further stage. Pullback composition identifies its limit pullback with the original map W→p_i^*V_i.

Evaluate the defining transpose formula for the approximation transition on V_i. Its restriction along the descended map equals the inverse-image unit applied to the restricted section of F. This follows from naturality of the unit and the pullback composition isomorphisms on sections. That restricted section is zero; hence its unit image is zero. Naturality of germs transports this zero germ to P(A(f))(t).

lean.statement: theorem affineLimitSheafApproximation_germ_eventually_zero {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] (s : Cone D) (hs : IsLimit s) (F : Sheaf s.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (x : s.pt) : let A := Etale.AffineLimitSheafApproximation.approximationDiagram D s F let P : Sheaf s.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} := (pointSmallEtale (s.pt.algClosurePoint x)).sheafFiber ∀ (i : Iᵒᵖ) (t : P.obj (A.obj i)), P.map ((Etale.AffineLimitSheafApproximation.approximationCocone D s F).ι.app i) t = 0 → ∃ (j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), P.map (A.map f) t = 0
